# Byte Matrix Technologies

> Byte Matrix Technologies is an ICT company in Nairobi, Kenya delivering enterprise IT solutions, managed services, networking, CCTV, and cybersecurity to organisations across East Africa.

- [Portfolio](/portfolio): Selected IT projects, case studies, and client outcomes.
- [Careers](/careers): Open roles, culture, and how to join the team.
- [Contact](/contact): Phone, email, location, and consultation requests.
